name: Verify imposibility of adding extra discounted Mocha after adding 3 cups of coffee to the cart
description: As a user, I want to ensure that when I add a discounted Mocha to the cart after adding 3 random items, I cannot add another one at the same discounted price, so that I can only benefit from the discount once per order.
